markers.impact: Altered Type I collagen transcription / bone density reduction
markers.interpretation: The COL1A1 Sp1 T-allele alters transcription factors, leading to a minor reduction in collagen Type I strength. It is replicated in studies showing reduced bone mineral density, osteopenic fracture risk, and soft-tissue injury susceptibility.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Common polymorphism with modest odds ratio; bone density is heavily driven by resistance training, vitamin D/K2 status, and hormonal balance.

sources.name: COL1A1 Sp1 polymorphism and osteoporosis
sources.notes: Large multi-cohort replication study confirming bone density reduction in T-carriers.

markers.impact: Altered Type V collagen mRNA stability / tendon-ligament laxity
markers.interpretation: COL5A1 rs12722 regulates Type V collagen, which controls fibril diameter in tendons and ligaments. The T allele is linked to mechanical property variations; C/C genotypes often display higher range of motion, while T/T has been associated with tendon injury susceptibility.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Array genotyping does not rule out rare coding mutations in COL5A1/COL5A2 that cause classical Ehlers-Danlos Syndrome.

sources.name: COL5A1 and Range of Motion
sources.notes: Associates the UTR variant with flexibility and tendon strain risks.

markers.impact: Type III collagen protein structure variation
markers.interpretation: COL3A1 Ala531Thr has been investigated in relation to tissue elasticity and pelvic/mitral valve laxity. It represents a common research variant, not a pathogenic mutation, and does not indicate vascular pathology.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: This common variant is benign in ClinVar. Do not mistake common SNPs for rare syndromic mutations (e.g. pathogenic COL3A1 variants causing vascular EDS).

sources.name: COL3A1 Ala531Thr in joint laxity cohorts
sources.notes: Common population variant with no pathogenic association for vascular syndromes.

markers.impact: Reduced growth differentiation factor 5 expression / joint cartilage remodeling
markers.interpretation: GDF5 is involved in joint development and cartilage repair. The T allele is associated with lower GDF5 promoter activity, showing a robust association with minor increases in osteoarthritis susceptibility (particularly knee and hip).
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Highly common allele; cartilage loss is also driven by mechanical loading, joint alignment, and systemic inflammatory tone.

sources.name: GDF5 promoter polymorphism association with osteoarthritis
sources.notes: Large replication study demonstrating functional promoter reduction.

markers.impact: Altered matrix metalloproteinase 3 expression / tissue remodeling
markers.interpretation: MMP3 breaks down extracellular matrix. The 5A allele (represented by A) has higher transcription activity than 6A, altering matrix remodeling rates in tendons and ligaments. Replicated in studies of Achilles tendon injury risk.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Extracellular matrix remodeling is complex and influenced by growth factors, nutrition (ascorbate), and mechanical loading schedules.

sources.name: MMP3 promoter polymorphism and tendon pathology
sources.notes: Replicates association of the 5A/6A promoter polymorphism with Achilles tendinopathy.

markers.impact: Fibrillin-1 structural integrity / aortic wall tension variation
markers.interpretation: The FBN1 rs2118181 T allele is associated with increased susceptibility to sporadic thoracic aortic dissection and aneurysm in the general population, affecting baseline tissue elasticity. It is NOT diagnostic of syndromic Marfan syndrome.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Intronic marker with minor risk effect; does not screen for rare pathogenic FBN1 stop/missense mutations.

sources.name: FBN1 variants and sporadic thoracic aortic dissection
sources.notes: GWAS showing association of 15q21.1 variants with thoracic aortic aneurysm.

markers.impact: Fibrillin-1 microfibril structure / height variation
markers.interpretation: FBN1 rs8033037 is a common variant investigated in genome-wide association studies for tall stature and bone elongation in the general population. It reflects minor, non-pathogenic variation in microfibril assembly.
confirm_with: skeletal measurements (arm span to height ratio)
clinical exam for Marfan skeletal signs
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Benign polymorphism; does not predict connective tissue disease.

sources.name: FBN1 polymorphisms and height variation in healthy populations
sources.notes: Associates common FBN1 coding SNPs with normal anthropometric distribution.

markers.impact: Alpha-actinin-3 deficiency / fast-twitch power reduction
markers.interpretation: ACTN3 R577X. Two T copies are associated with absence of alpha-actinin-3 in fast fibers in relevant research, but performance is influenced by training and many other factors; this marker does not determine sprint or endurance ability.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Muscle composition is heavily determined by resistance and anaerobic physical training regimes.

sources.name: ACTN3 genotype and athletic performance
sources.notes: Identifies R577X as a key regulator of fast-twitch skeletal muscle properties.

markers.impact: Altered collagen XII expression / ACL injury risk
markers.interpretation: COL12A1 rs970547 regulates Type XII collagen. The T allele is linked in association studies to altered baseline ligament properties, showing elevated susceptibility to ACL tears.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Common modifier; injury risk is primarily driven by biomechanics, warmups, and joint loading patterns.

sources.name: COL12A1 and ACL injury risk
sources.notes: Associates COL12A1 variants with cruciate ligament tears in female cohorts.

markers.impact: Altered gelatinase B expression / matrix remodeling
markers.interpretation: MMP9 regulates gelatinase B, which cleaves collagen Type IV. The T allele increases promoter activity, modifying extracellular matrix remodeling in cardiovascular tissues and joint cartilage.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Overall enzyme activity is guided by secondary factors (zinc/calcium availability).

sources.name: MMP9 promoter polymorphism expression
sources.notes: Shows elevated transcription driven by the -1562T allele.

markers.impact: Altered type I collagen transcription / bone and tendon matrix modifier
markers.interpretation: COL1A1 promoter variation can modestly influence type I collagen expression and downstream bone/tendon matrix properties. Treat as a small modifier of bone-density and tendon-resilience context, not a monogenic disorder signal.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Common COL1A1 regulatory markers do not screen for rare COL1A1 pathogenic variants that cause osteogenesis imperfecta or EDS-like syndromes.

sources.name: LRP5 variants and bone mineral density
sources.notes: LRP5 common variants influence WNT signaling and modestly affect BMD/fracture traits.

markers.impact: Type I collagen alpha-2 chain variation / ligament and tendon stiffness modifier
markers.interpretation: COL1A2 common variants have been studied for tendon, ligament, and bone-density traits. Evidence is inconsistent and should be treated as a weak matrix-integrity modifier only.
confirm_with: clinical collagen gene panel if syndromic features exist
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Consumer SNPs do not evaluate the broad set of rare COL1A2 missense/splice/CNV variants relevant to clinical collagenopathies.

sources.notes: OI is genetically heterogeneous; common dominant forms are often COL1A1/COL1A2 while many recessive genes affect collagen processing/mineralization.

markers.impact: Type V collagen expression variation / tendon and ligament injury susceptibility
markers.interpretation: COL5A1 regulates collagen fibril diameter. rs13946 is commonly evaluated with rs12722 as part of COL5A1 tendon-ligament susceptibility research. Effects are modest and population-dependent.
confirm_with: clinical COL5A1/COL5A2 sequencing if cEDS signs exist
markers.raw_dna_limitation: This is not a pathogenic cEDS variant; rare coding/splice variants require clinical sequencing.

sources.notes: Reported association between COL5A1 rs12722 and tendon/ligament injuries, especially in Caucasian cohorts.

sources.notes: cEDS diagnosis is established with characteristic features plus pathogenic variants in COL1A1, COL5A1, or COL5A2.

markers.impact: Altered tendon extracellular matrix signaling / Achilles tendinopathy modifier
markers.interpretation: TNC encodes tenascin-C, an extracellular matrix glycoprotein expressed during tendon loading and repair. rs2104772 has been investigated in Achilles tendinopathy cohorts as a common susceptibility marker.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Tendon injury is dominated by load progression, recovery, footwear, biomechanics, and age; this marker is not clinically diagnostic.

sources.name: Tenascin-C variants and Achilles tendon injury research
sources.notes: Research literature evaluating TNC polymorphisms in Achilles tendon pathology.

markers.impact: Angiogenesis signaling variation / tendon and wound-healing context
markers.interpretation: VEGFA controls angiogenesis during tendon repair and wound healing. rs2010963 may modify VEGF expression, but evidence for usable musculoskeletal prediction is weak.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: VEGF biology is context-sensitive; inflammation, hypoxia, diabetes and mechanical loading dominate phenotype.

sources.name: VEGFA polymorphisms and tissue repair
sources.notes: Exploratory studies of VEGFA polymorphisms in repair and vascularization traits.

markers.impact: VEGF promoter activity variation / angiogenesis and repair modifier
markers.interpretation: The VEGFA rs699947 A allele has been studied for altered promoter activity and angiogenesis-related traits. In connective-tissue interpretation it is only a weak modifier of repair context.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Do not infer repair speed from this SNP; local injury environment and metabolic status are stronger predictors.

sources.name: VEGFA -2578C>A and angiogenesis-related traits
sources.notes: Common promoter variant studied across angiogenesis-related phenotypes.

markers.impact: TGF-beta signaling variation / fibrosis, scarring and bone-remodeling context
markers.interpretation: TGFB1 regulates extracellular matrix deposition, collagen synthesis, immune signaling and fibrosis. rs1800470 can be treated as a low-penetrance modifier of scarring/fibrotic tendency and bone turnover, not a diagnostic marker.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: TGF-beta effects differ by tissue, injury state, immune tone and ancestry; single-SNP interpretation is fragile.

sources.name: TGFB1 polymorphisms and tissue fibrosis / bone remodeling
sources.notes: TGFB1 is involved in extracellular matrix remodeling, scarring and bone turnover; common SNP interpretation is low-penetrance.

markers.impact: Altered TGF-beta secretion / matrix deposition modifier
markers.interpretation: TGFB1 rs1800471 has been studied in bone-density, fibrosis and immune-remodeling phenotypes. Use only as a weak context marker for matrix remodeling and scar behavior.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: The phenotype depends heavily on tissue injury, inflammation, hormones and metabolic status.

sources.name: TGFB1 polymorphisms and tissue fibrosis / bone remodeling
sources.notes: TGFB1 is involved in extracellular matrix remodeling, scarring and bone turnover; common SNP interpretation is low-penetrance.

markers.impact: Inflammatory cytokine expression variation / tendon pain and cartilage remodeling modifier
markers.interpretation: IL6 influences inflammation, pain signaling, cartilage metabolism and repair. rs1800795 may alter promoter activity, but musculoskeletal interpretation should remain inflammatory-context only.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Cytokine SNP effects are small, ancestry-dependent and strongly overridden by infection, adiposity, training load and sleep.

sources.name: IL6 promoter polymorphism and musculoskeletal inflammation
sources.notes: Studies evaluate IL6 promoter variants in inflammation and joint disease contexts.

markers.impact: TNF-alpha inflammatory tone / cartilage and tendon pain susceptibility modifier
markers.interpretation: TNF-alpha is a major inflammatory cytokine involved in pain, synovitis and tissue catabolism. The rs1800629 A allele has been studied as a higher-expression inflammatory marker in many conditions.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: TNF genotype does not replace clinical inflammatory markers, imaging or rheumatology evaluation.

sources.name: TNF -308 polymorphism and inflammatory musculoskeletal traits
sources.notes: Common promoter variant studied across inflammatory and degenerative joint conditions.

markers.impact: Estrogen receptor signaling variation / ligament laxity and bone density context
markers.interpretation: ESR1 affects collagen metabolism, ligament response and bone turnover. rs2234693 is a common estrogen receptor polymorphism studied in bone-density and injury-risk phenotypes.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Sex hormone exposure, age, training and vitamin D/calcium status dominate phenotype.

sources.name: ESR1 polymorphisms and bone density / ligament traits
sources.notes: Studies examine ESR1 polymorphisms in BMD and ligament-related traits.

markers.impact: Estrogen receptor variation / bone turnover and soft-tissue remodeling modifier
markers.interpretation: ESR1 rs9340799 is often studied with rs2234693 for bone-density and connective-tissue phenotypes. Treat as a modest endocrine-matrix interaction marker.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Effects are small and depend on age, sex hormones, mechanical loading and mineral status.

sources.name: ESR1 XbaI and bone/connective tissue traits
sources.notes: ESR1 XbaI polymorphism research in bone density and fracture traits.

markers.impact: Vitamin D receptor activity variation / bone mineralization context
markers.interpretation: VDR FokI changes the VDR protein start site and is commonly studied in bone mineral density and fracture susceptibility. It is a mineralization-context marker, not a standalone osteoporosis screen.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: VDR genotype does not indicate actual vitamin D status; measure serum 25-OH vitamin D.

sources.name: VDR FokI and bone mineral density research
sources.notes: Common VDR variant studied in BMD and fracture risk.

markers.impact: Vitamin D receptor regulatory variation / bone density modifier
markers.interpretation: VDR BsmI is a common regulatory polymorphism associated inconsistently with bone mineral density. Interpret only alongside measured vitamin D and bone-density phenotype.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Common VDR polymorphisms have small effects and vary by ancestry, age, sex and nutrition.

sources.name: VDR BsmI and bone mineral density research
sources.notes: Research on VDR BsmI polymorphism and bone mineral density.

markers.impact: Reduced WNT co-receptor signaling / lower bone mineral density susceptibility
markers.interpretation: LRP5 participates in canonical WNT signaling, a major regulator of bone formation. rs3736228 has replicated associations with modestly lower BMD and fracture susceptibility.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: This is a common low-effect marker; rare pathogenic LRP5 variants require clinical sequencing.

sources.name: LRP5 variants and bone mineral density
sources.notes: LRP5 common variants influence WNT signaling and modestly affect BMD/fracture traits.

sources.name: WNT signaling loci and bone mineral density / fracture risk
sources.notes: WNT pathway common variants are replicated contributors to bone mineral density and fracture susceptibility.

markers.impact: WNT pathway variation / bone density modifier
markers.interpretation: LRP5 rs4988321 is a common WNT-pathway variant studied in relation to bone-density traits. It may provide weak context for skeletal loading and mineralization tendency.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Single LRP5 SNPs do not detect monogenic high-bone-mass or osteoporosis-pseudoglioma syndromes.

sources.name: LRP5 variants and bone mineral density
sources.notes: LRP5 common variants influence WNT signaling and modestly affect BMD/fracture traits.

markers.impact: Altered cortical bone thickness / fracture susceptibility modifier
markers.interpretation: WNT16 is strongly implicated in cortical bone thickness and fracture susceptibility. Common variants near WNT16 are useful as low-effect bone-strength context markers.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: WNT16 common variants do not replace bone-density testing or fracture-risk tools.

sources.name: WNT signaling loci and bone mineral density / fracture risk
sources.notes: WNT pathway common variants are replicated contributors to bone mineral density and fracture susceptibility.

markers.impact: WNT signaling variation / cortical bone and fracture context
markers.interpretation: rs2707466 is a WNT16-region marker studied in bone mineral density and fracture GWAS. Treat as a modest cortical-bone architecture signal.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Effect size is small and population-calibrated PRS is more informative than a single SNP.

sources.name: WNT signaling loci and bone mineral density / fracture risk
sources.notes: WNT pathway common variants are replicated contributors to bone mineral density and fracture susceptibility.

markers.impact: Altered WNT inhibition / bone formation signaling modifier
markers.interpretation: SOST encodes sclerostin, an inhibitor of bone formation. Common SOST-region variants may modestly influence BMD and bone formation signaling.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Clinical interpretation requires phenotype; SOST effects are embedded in WNT-pathway network behavior.

sources.name: SOST polymorphisms and bone mineral density
sources.notes: Common variants near SOST studied in BMD and fracture-related traits.

markers.impact: Osteoprotegerin signaling variation / bone resorption context
markers.interpretation: TNFRSF11B encodes osteoprotegerin, a regulator of RANKL-mediated osteoclast activation. rs2073618 has been studied in osteoporosis, BMD and vascular calcification contexts.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Bone resorption is influenced by hormones, inflammation, vitamin D status, kidney function and mechanical loading.

sources.name: TNFRSF11B rs2073618 and bone mineral density
sources.notes: Studies examine OPG pathway polymorphisms in BMD and fracture risk.

markers.impact: RANKL pathway variation / osteoclast activation context
markers.interpretation: TNFSF11 encodes RANKL, the main osteoclast-activation signal. Common RANKL-region variants have been studied in BMD and fracture susceptibility.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Use as pathway context only; labs and DEXA dominate interpretation.

sources.name: TNFSF11/RANKL variants and bone mineral density
sources.notes: RANKL pathway common variants studied in bone mineral density.

markers.impact: Matrix metalloproteinase-1 expression variation / collagen breakdown modifier
markers.interpretation: MMP1 initiates interstitial collagen degradation. The 2G promoter allele is associated with higher transcription in several contexts, potentially shifting matrix turnover and scar/tendon remodeling.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: MMP activity depends on local inflammation, TIMP balance, mechanical loading and tissue injury phase.

sources.name: MMP1 1G/2G promoter polymorphism and matrix remodeling
sources.notes: Promoter indel studied in collagen turnover, fibrosis, scarring and degenerative conditions.

markers.impact: Collagenase-3 expression variation / cartilage degradation context
markers.interpretation: MMP13 degrades type II collagen in cartilage and is biologically relevant to osteoarthritis and disc degeneration. rs2252070 has been studied as a regulatory marker.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Cartilage disease is biomechanical and inflammatory; MMP13 common variants are weak modifiers.

sources.name: MMP13 polymorphisms and osteoarthritis/cartilage degeneration
sources.notes: MMP13 regulatory variants studied in cartilage degeneration and OA.

markers.impact: MMP inhibition balance / extracellular matrix turnover modifier
markers.interpretation: TIMP2 inhibits matrix metalloproteinases and helps regulate collagen turnover. This marker is exploratory for connective-tissue remodeling balance.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: TIMP/MMP balance is tissue-specific and cannot be inferred reliably from one SNP.

sources.name: TIMP2 polymorphisms and extracellular matrix remodeling
sources.notes: Exploratory literature on TIMP2 variants in matrix remodeling traits.

markers.impact: Elastin fiber structure variation / arterial and skin elasticity context
markers.interpretation: ELN encodes elastin, central to arterial wall and skin elasticity. rs2071307 is a common coding variant studied in vascular stiffness and tissue-elasticity phenotypes.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Common ELN SNPs do not detect ELN deletions or rare pathogenic variants causing elastinopathies.

sources.name: ELN rs2071307 and vascular/tissue elasticity
sources.notes: ELN common variants studied in arterial stiffness and elasticity traits.

markers.impact: Lysyl oxidase collagen/elastin crosslinking variation
markers.interpretation: LOX catalyzes collagen and elastin crosslinking. rs1800449 has been studied in bone density, aortic wall integrity and extracellular matrix strength.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: LOX biology is also influenced by copper status, hypoxia, inflammation and rare pathogenic variants; this common SNP is not diagnostic.

sources.name: LOX rs1800449 and connective tissue/bone traits
sources.notes: Common LOX variant studied in bone and vascular connective-tissue traits.

markers.impact: Local thyroid hormone activation variation / osteoarthritis and cartilage context
markers.interpretation: DIO2 affects local T3 availability in cartilage and bone. Common DIO2 variation has been studied in osteoarthritis susceptibility and cartilage metabolism, but interpretation is research-only.
confirm_with: TSH/free T4/free T3 if clinically relevant
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Do not use this SNP to infer systemic thyroid status or cartilage disease.

sources.name: DIO2 polymorphisms and osteoarthritis/cartilage metabolism
sources.notes: Research on DIO2 variation in osteoarthritis and cartilage biology.

markers.impact: Collagen breakdown variation / periodontal and matrix remodeling context
markers.interpretation: MMP8 degrades fibrillar collagens and is relevant to periodontal/connective tissue turnover. Common variants may influence tissue breakdown under inflammatory conditions.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Periodontal connective tissue loss is dominated by oral microbiome, hygiene, immune tone and smoking.

sources.name: MMP8 polymorphisms and periodontal/connective tissue remodeling
sources.notes: MMP8 variants studied in periodontal and collagen breakdown phenotypes.

markers.impact: Bone mechanotransduction and inflammation modifier
markers.interpretation: P2RX7 participates in inflammatory signaling and bone remodeling. rs1718119 has been studied in bone-density and fracture contexts but has limited standalone utility.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Purinergic signaling is context-dependent; this is not a clinical bone fragility marker.

sources.name: P2RX7 rs1718119 and bone mineral density research
sources.notes: P2RX7 variants studied in bone density and fracture susceptibility.

markers.impact: Osteopontin expression variation / bone remodeling and tendon repair context
markers.interpretation: SPP1 encodes osteopontin, involved in mineralized tissue remodeling and injury repair. Common variants are research-only connective-tissue context markers.
markers.raw_dna_limitation: Osteopontin signaling is highly injury- and inflammation-dependent.

sources.name: SPP1 polymorphisms and bone/connective tissue remodeling
sources.notes: SPP1 variants studied in bone remodeling and inflammatory repair contexts.
